# Shop: commissioning procedure

Version 1.0.0 of the specification: 2 checks run on the installed system before it is handed over, and the sign-off sheet. Fill in the Result column as each step is run; the filled-in run is kept as a record under `records/commissioning/`, beside the specification, not in it.

## 1. Checks in staging

### whole-sale (end-to-end)

One sale goes through with the real printer.

Verifies SHOP-1.

**Insight:** The printer is the part a test bench does not have.

**Note:** From IEC 62381, Factory, site and site integration acceptance tests, 2024: A site acceptance test runs on the installed system in its real environment.

| Step | Action | Expected | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. Sell | Ring up one item and take cash. | The receipt prints with the right total. |   |
